claim_boundary: This primary-source retry supports exactly one separately frozen, unlevered, equal-capital pre-outcome DRA participation design audit. It does not establish transfer to BTC, prediction, alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability, or Trading authority.

prior_matrix.identity: Moreira and Muir, Volatility-Managed Portfolios, NBER Working Paper 22208 and Journal of Finance 72 (2017) 1611-1644
prior_matrix.finding: Across multiple equity factors and currency carry, reducing exposure following high lagged volatility produced positive spanning alphas and higher Sharpe ratios because expected returns did not rise proportionally with volatility.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The evidence is multi-factor and commonly uses volatility scaling; it does not prove a single unlevered BTC spot DRA entry-admission rule.

prior_matrix.identity: Cederburg, O'Doherty, Wang and Yan, On the performance of volatility-managed portfolios, Journal of Financial Economics 138 (2020) 95-117
prior_matrix.finding: Across 103 equity strategies, volatility-managed portfolios did not systematically beat unmanaged portfolios in direct comparisons; implementable out-of-sample versions generally had lower certainty-equivalent returns and Sharpe ratios, with structural instability in spanning regressions.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A positive in-sample or spanning result is insufficient. Any BTC audit must be causal, fixed before outcomes, cost-aware, equal-capital, and fail closed on Validation or breadth.

prior_matrix.identity: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu, Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency, Journal of Finance 77 (2022) 1133-1177
prior_matrix.finding: The paper studies cross-sectional cryptocurrency market, size, and momentum factors and shows that a three-factor model accounts for the reported long-short factor strategies.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Cross-sectional cryptocurrency factor evidence is not single-BTC time-series volatility-management evidence.

real_time_design_requirements: Use only lagged information available before the next-bar fill.
Keep the DRA parent, exits, side, lot cost, capacity, fee, and adverse slippage unchanged.
Compare under equal initial capital and report realized, unrealized, total PnL, drawdown, holding, utilization, underwater duration, and terminal inventory.
Freeze no more than three variants before execution and prohibit outcome-aware tuning.
Require Design and Validation improvement, annual breadth, path-risk non-inferiority, and neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a candidate from this prior audit.
uncertainty: Single-BTC DRA transfer remains unproven until the separately frozen economic screen runs.
The positive and falsification priors conflict, so a negative or unstable screen must close the family without tuning.
No post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, or Trading path was accessed or authorized.
